Love gets a review as Venus retrograde in your Fifth House trines Pluto in your Ninth, making an old flirtation feel magnetic. Money needs patience as the Moon in your Eighth House squares Saturn in your Eleventh, so review shared expenses carefully. Saturday is your power day because Mercury direct sharpens your mind. Sunday is harder because the Moon opposes Jupiter, tempting overspending. Follow for daily cosmic updates.
